description: GST show cause notice that gives no reply date or period
text:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE - NOT A REAL NOTICE
Office of the Deputy Commissioner of CGST, Division Demo, Bengaluru
Date: 03/10/2026

Show Cause Notice under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017
GSTIN 29ABCDE0000A1Z5

You are required to explain why tax of Rs. 62,000/- should not be demanded for the quarter ending June 2026. Please submit your explanation to this office along with supporting documents.
